newsitem.title: FINLAND: SANTASALO SAYS TO INVEST FIM 11 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SANTASALO SAYS TO INVEST FIM 11 MILLION.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Santasalo-JOT Oy said on Tuesday it would invest 11 million markka to boost the annual output capacity of its JOT Components unit Suomivalimo Oy by 25 percent.
"The capacity increase is due to the JOT Components Suomivalimo Oy's significant new deals and the current clients favourable market prospects," Santasalo-JOT said in a statement.
The aim is to up Suomivalimo's capacity to 10.5 tonnes from 8.5 tonnes, Santasalo said.
Through the investments 10 to 15 new jobs will be created, it added.
